headline: 暑期档尾声：今日零上映，本周三部新片
headlineEn: End of summer season: zero releases today, three new films this week
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共3部新片。热搜由《绿灯军团》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》领衔，玩具总动员5、逃出绝命街等持续受关注，暂无后续重点档期安排。
summaryEn: No films released today; three new movies this week. Trending led by Green Lantern Corps, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and The Odyssey, with Toy Story 5 and Escape from Death Street also drawing attention. No notable upcoming releases.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有3部新片与观众见面
industryHighlights.en: Three new movies hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》领跑今日及本周热搜
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps leads both today's and weekly trending charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等多部大片热度持续
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day and other major titles remain hot.

industryHighlights.text: 未来暂无显著新片定档消息
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming release dates announced.
